description: This source file implements a test application for web configuration scenarios, including socket server setup, handling different test scenarios (ACK, NACK, timeout, max timeout), and simulating client requests via socket communication. It also includes functions for registering sub-documents and executing test cases with random data.

classes.name: teststruct
classes.description: Structure holding three integer test values.

classes.name: execData
classes.description: Structure for executing blob requests, including transaction ID, version, number of entries, subdoc name, user data, and callback functions.

methods.name: getV
methods.description: Returns version number based on subdoc name.

methods.name: setV
methods.description: Sets the version number for a subdoc.

methods.name: scenario_ACK
methods.description: Simulates an acknowledgment scenario, returning success.

methods.name: scenario_NACK
methods.description: Simulates a negative acknowledgment scenario, returning failure.

methods.name: scenario_TimeOut
methods.description: Simulates a timeout scenario with delay.

methods.name: scenario_MAXTIMEOUT
methods.description: Simulates a maximum timeout scenario with extended delay.

methods.name: callTestFunc
methods.description: Runs various test scenarios based on user input, including socket server setup and request simulation.

methods.name: create_server
methods.description: Creates a TCP socket server to accept client requests and trigger test scenarios.

methods.name: InitAndDeamonize
methods.description: Initializes registration and starts server in a daemon thread.
